newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil gets no boost from crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil gets no boost from crude.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run failed to capitalise on firmer crude and prices were a touch lower.
Dealers said buyers were keeping away from the market as straight run remains too expensive refineries.
A September cargo was heard offered at $122 fob NWE and a Zawia cargo that had been offered at $126.50 cif NWE has been kept in system because the price was not thought achievable.
High sulphur straight run was steady with prices for E-4 holding around formula +$4/4.50.
